1.title: Inside Israel’s Secret Operation to Cultivate Ahmadinejad
1.summary: The yearslong effort to groom the former Iranian president as an intelligence asset culminated in a dramatic effort to take him to an Israeli safe house in the early days of the war. But the plan fell apart.

2.title: Lindsey Graham’s Sister Darline Nordone Was His Family
2.summary: After the senator and his sister, Darline, lost their parents, he guided her through the teenage years and into college. He called her success the highlight of his life.

3.title: Lindsey Graham Had a Complicated Relationship With Black Voters
3.summary: Mr. Graham, a long-serving senator from South Carolina, was known for his ability to maintain relationships even with his political foes. But the support of Black voters remained elusive.

4.title: Live Updates: Iran Ramps Up Threats as It Retaliates Against U.S. Strikes
4.summary: Senior Iranian officials called for revenge against the United States and Israel for killing the late supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as a new exchange of attacks pushed the region into deeper uncertainty.

5.title: Wildfire raging south of Paris could have been set deliberately, says minister
5.summary: It was the first time firefighting planes had been sent up from the normally drier and hotter south of the country to tackle fires in the Paris region.

6.title: Lebanese Hold Fast to Their Land Despite Threat of Long Israeli Occupation
6.summary: Entire towns in southern Lebanon have been hollowed out by the war between Israel and Hezbollah. Some residents have stayed, fearing permanent displacement.
